alt: 孩子在很近的距離從容投擲沙包，前幾次都已穩穩投入寬大的圓洞，這次也對準目標，同伴安心地看著。
scene_prompt: 十拿九穩 means having a very high likelihood of success, being very sure before doing it. Modern indoor children's beanbag target game in a school gym. One confident older child stands very close to a large low wooden target with a wide round hole, calmly aiming a soft beanbag with a practiced relaxed smile. Several identical beanbags already lie successfully inside the open basket directly behind the hole, visible through the target's side, showing repeated reliable success; the next beanbag is gently underhand tossed on a short clear arc directly toward the wide hole. A friend beside the child watches with a reassured smile, hands relaxed, expecting success. Make the short distance and easy well-practiced throw unmistakable. Two children only, natural grounded posture, each exactly two arms and legs, one tossed beanbag and a few landed ones, simple stable grounded target stand. No scoreboard, numbers, letters, text, logos, arrows or speech bubbles. Convey very high confidence rather than celebrating an unexpected lucky win.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist.
